name: TAS58xx
description: The `tas58xx` platform allows your ESPHome devices to use the Texas Instruments TAS58xx family of stereo Class-D audio amplifiers with digital (I²S) input. This allows the playback of audio via the microcontroller from a range of sources via [Speaker](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/) or [Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/).

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The I²C address of the amplifier. The address is selected with a resistor on the `ADR` pin (see the datasheet). Defaults to `0x2D` for `tas5805m` and `0x4C` for `tas5825m`.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The I²C address of the amplifier. The address is selected with a resistor on the `ADR` pin (see the datasheet). Defaults to `0x2D` for `tas5805m` and `0x4C` for `tas5825m`.

config_entries.label: I2C ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the [I²C bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/) the amplifier is connected to.

config_entries.label: Update Interval
config_entries.description: How often the fault and power state registers are read. Defaults to `1s`.

config_entries.label: Enable Pin
config_entries.description: The pin connected to the `PDN` (power down) pin of the amplifier. During setup the pin is briefly driven low and then high to power up the amplifier cleanly. Omit if `PDN` is hardwired high. Without this pin, and with `PDN` not pulled high, the amplifier does not respond on I²C and setup fails.

config_entries.label: Mode
config_entries.description: Pin mode flags (input / output / pullup / pulldown / open_drain). Combine flags as needed — e.g. input + pullup for a button pulled to VCC.

config_entries.label: Open Drain
config_entries.description: Set the open drain mode flag.

config_entries.label: Inverted
config_entries.description: Invert the logical level. ``true`` swaps high/low in software so an active-low button reads as active when grounded.

config_entries.label: Analog Gain
config_entries.description: The analog gain of the output stage, in `0.5dB` steps. Use it to match the output swing to the supply voltage. Range: `-15.5dB` to `0dB`. Defaults to `-15.5dB`, the lowest gain.

config_entries.label: DAC Mode
config_entries.description: How the output stage drives the speakers. Defaults to `btl`.

options.label: pbtl
options.description: Parallel bridge tied load, one speaker driven by both output channels. Requires mixer_mode to be mono, left or right.

config_entries.label: Ignore Enable Pin Warning
config_entries.description: Set to `true` to hide the config validation warning shown when `enable_pin` is not set. Use this when `PDN` is hardwired high. Cannot be used together with `enable_pin`. Defaults to `false`.

config_entries.label: Mixer Mode
config_entries.description: How the left and right input channels are routed to the outputs. Defaults to `stereo`.

options.label: stereo
options.description: Left input to the left output, right input to the right output.

options.label: mono
options.description: Left and right mixed (each at -6 dB) to both outputs.

config_entries.label: Volume Max Db
config_entries.description: The digital volume that maps to the maximum volume (100%). Must be greater than `volume_min_db`. Range: `-103dB` to `24dB`. Defaults to `24dB`.

config_entries.label: Volume Min Db
config_entries.description: The digital volume that maps to the minimum volume (0%). Must be less than `volume_max_db`. Range: `-103dB` to `24dB`. Defaults to `-103dB`.
